notes: Eval 1 (no-args) is the key discriminating test: with_skill scores 0.75 vs old_skill 0.50. The new SKILL.md frontmatter pipeline context is the differentiator.
Eval 2 (bare-topic) and Eval 3 (full-invocation) show near-identical pass rates. Both configurations handle the interaction flow correctly for these cases.
Assertion 4 in eval-1 ('mentions /hook') is likely too strict — mentioning /hook before a brief exists is premature. This assertion explains the 0.75 ceiling on with_skill in eval-1.
Assertion 4 in eval-2 ('shows command syntax') fires at the wrong stage — command is shown at confirmation, not at list stage. Contributes to both configs missing it.
Token usage is nearly identical across configs (37K ± 500), suggesting the new frontmatter adds minimal overhead.
Qualitative difference on eval-2: with_skill flags relevant repos by topic; old_skill lists them without topic-guided recommendations — not captured by current assertions.
